acceptance_predicates.description: Complete immutable runtime releases are staged only beneath the fixed owner-controlled versioned store.
Release admission uses a concrete trust-policy verifier for source/tag identity and authenticity evidence.
Symlink, hard-link, ownership, mode, path-escape, unallowlisted-file, and identity-drift faults reject closed.
Existing flat installations remain functional for normal use and remain ineligible for upgrade publication.

definition_of_done: Hostile staging and validation tests cover filesystem, manifest, trust-policy, and process/failure boundaries.
Independent review and hosted quality/formal checks pass for one exact product revision.
Public apply, rollback, release, and Dispatch remain rejection-only; no source-to-model refinement proof or authorization prerequisite is required.

inputs.description: AR-0090 fixed selected-runtime consumer and retained validation boundary.
Existing typed selector-admission seam and atomic selector/reconciliation primitives.

outputs.description: A separately reviewable versioned runtime staging and validation boundary.
A concrete, testable release authenticity/trust-policy verifier.

gates.description: All evidence identifies one product revision.
A separate review worker passes before merge.
The slice does not enable public upgrade mutation.
